title: CochleaNet: deep learning analysis of cochlear connectomics and gene therapy
summary: CochleaNet segments the cochlea from light-sheet volumes of cleared, labelled tissue, including inner hair cells, spiral ganglion neurons and their synapses, and analyses tonotopy and gene expression. It was validated against manual analysis and outperformed prior segmentation methods. The authors used it to compare spiral ganglion neuron types and to assess different gene therapy products.
ai_technology: CochleaNet: deep learning framework for volumetric image segmentation and analysis
organization: University Medical Center Göttingen; University of Göttingen; Cluster of Excellence MBExC

evidence.tested: Compared with manual image analysis and prior segmentation methods, then used to validate different gene therapy products in cochleae.
evidence.unknown: Generalisation to other cochlear datasets or species is not stated in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning framework that reconstructs the cochlea and segments hair cells, neurons and synapses, and quantifies tonotopy and gene expression.
